items.reason: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:19 initializes only sgMail, while the new cancellation request at line 57 uses the separately imported client. The locked SendGrid 7.7.0 [MailService implementation](https://github.com/sendgrid/sendgrid-nodejs/blob/7.7.0/packages/mail/src/classes/mail-service.js#L16-L38) creates its own Client, so setting its API key does not authenticate the separate client. Consequently, cancellation requests fail and leave reminders scheduled; emailReminderManager.ts:25-26 correctly initializes both clients.
